idea-plugin.name: Clipboard Directory Sync
idea-plugin.description: Sync source-code directories between a host and a remote desktop through a shared text clipboard. Select entire folders in a hierarchical checkbox tree, transfer automatically with acknowledgements and retries, and preview updates before applying. 通过目录树勾选文件夹，支持自动收发、差异预览及直接同步，不生成备份。
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.3.0: Added hierarchical folder selection with partial-selection indicators in send and receive views. Removed backup creation and restore actions. Automatic clipboard transfer remains compatible with 0.2.0.
